Build a full app from one prompt. Free for a month (normally $25). Claim it while it lasts.

Caffeine is an AI app builder, a bit like Lovable, where agents build and host your app. This is its Studio plan.

Open to anyone without a paid plan, not only students. We claimed it ourselves and it works.

Studio gives you:

→ 115 credits, pick your model
→ Exportable code

What 115 credits buys (tokens in / out):

• DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: 287M / 115M
• Mistral Large 4: 42M / 13.8M
• Kimi K3: 30M / 6M
• Sonnet 5.5 & GPT-6 Sol: 28.7M / 5.7M
• Opus 5.5: 14.4M / 2.9M

How to claim:

1. Sign in at https://t.co/llFrrMIERR with Google
2. Name (bottom left) → Account settings → Plans & billing
3. Use code → enter HALLOWEEN26
4. Check out with a card ($1 charge, refunded in minutes)

Cancel right after so it doesn’t renew: Plans & billing → Cancel → Cancel at period end (skip “Switch to Host”). You keep Studio for the month.

Works till Nov 30. Card required. Not our promo, and it can end anytime.
